3908422.baseName: Habitat 6ft Snow Tipped Pencil Christmas Tree
3908422.variantName: Habitat 6ft Snow Tipped Pencil Christmas Tree
3908422.sourceDescription: Bring festive cheer into tighter spaces with this slimline 6ft pencil tree. It's designed for compact footprints, so you can tuck it into the corner of a room without losing valuable floor space. The snow-tipped branches add that wintry touch, creating a cosy Christmas feel wherever you place it. It's made from PVC with hinged branches that make assembly simple, and it comes with a metal stand to keep everything stable. You can have it standing in minutes with minimal effort. Just slot the 2 pieces together into the base, pull down the hinged branches, and fluff them up so they look thick and full. No needles dropping on the carpet means no messy hoover sessions, and you can use it again and again, year after year. The flat needles across 297 tips give you plenty of surface to decorate, and it's a blank canvas ready for your lights and baubles. . w1005dhz.variantName: Walplus 150 Bright LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
w1005dhz.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is designed to bring the spirit of the festive season into your home with its sleek and modern appearance. Its cone-shaped design and dynamic LED light show make it a stunning centerpiece for your seasonal decor, perfect for creating a winter wonderland in both indoor and sheltered outdoor spaces. Crafted from abrasion-resistant materials like PVC and steel, this tree provides a durable and lasting addition to your holiday celebrations. Materials: This tree is crafted from PVC and steel, ensuring an abrasion-resistant and long-lasting build. The materials are selected to maintain their appearance over time, bringing joy year after year without wear. Included Components: It includes an LED string light with dynamic lighting patterns and a USB plug, making it easy to illuminate the space with vibrant lights. A sturdy steel stand is provided to keep the tree stable. Features /Function /Design: With eight LED flash modes, the lighting offers multiple visual experiences, from steady to dynamic displays, allowing you to customize the ambiance according to your mood or event. Recommended Uses: Suitable for the living room, garden, and terrace, this tree's versatility in design shines in any setting, enhancing the festive atmosphere wherever placed. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions using a screwdriver. The non-traditional USB plug offers a universal power source connection, ensuring easy setup and teardown. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Pink Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

mtt5z0j1.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree stand combines a beech wood base with a durable metal tube to provide stable support for artificial Christmas trees. The smooth wooden surface complements your tree, while the automatic folding structure allows the stand to be stored vertically when not in use, saving space. No tools are required for assembly; simply unfold the stand, insert the artificial tree into the metal tube and tighten the metal bolts to secure the tree. The low-base design helps keep trees stable and upright, reducing wobbling and the risk of tipping. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, it provides a practical foundation for artificial Christmas trees up to 7 ft tall. Specifications: Made from beech wood and metal, with an automatic folding structure for convenient storage. No tools required for assembly. Suitable for artificial Christmas trees up to 7 ft tall and designed for indoor and outdoor use. Dimensions: Base diameter 60 cm; metal tube diameter 14 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
